name: bellnote.children.list
description: List the children on this account with school, grade, homeroom, meal restrictions, default way home (only for a child you are custodial for) and every guardian's rights for each child, and the ID of each child's lunch account (null when the child has none).

name: bellnote.schools.get
description: Read one school: bell times, term, the effective policy (cut-off rules, pickup review, top-up range, meal debt limit) and, for start..end (dates, default today..+14), each calendar day with its kind, dismissal time and resolved cut-off instants.

name: bellnote.attendance.list
description: Attendance records by day (status, explained/unexplained, the office's excused/unexcused) for one child (id) or all children, in start..end (default the last 14 days). A day with no mark has no record.

name: bellnote.absences.list
description: Absence, late-arrival and early-leave reports with their state (submitted, excused, unexcused, cancelled, or moot when every day no longer applies: it became a closed day, or for a late arrival or early leave an early dismissal moved the end of the day to or before the reported time), moot_dates and per-day cut-offs. Filter by report id, child_id or state.

name: bellnote.forms.list
description: Forms addressed to the account's children with phase (closed once the due time passes; otherwise answered when every child in scope has a signed or declined answer, a needs_review answer not counting, else open), fee, due time, version and each child's answer (unanswered, signed, declined, withdrawn, needs_review).

name: bellnote.forms.get
description: Read one form: exact text, questions, fee, event date, due time, current version and version history, each addressed child's answer and your rights to sign and pay.

name: bellnote.pickup.get
description: Who may collect one child (id): guardians with can_pickup, standing pickup people by state, restrictions on file with the school office, the default way home, dismissal changes in start..end (default today..+14) and the resulting plan per day. Requires your custodial right for the child.

name: bellnote.lunch.account_get
description: Read one lunch account (id): balance, low-balance threshold, daily spending limit, the child's meal restrictions and the transactions in start..end (default the last 14 days), each with restricted_item and over_daily_limit computed at read time.

name: bellnote.menu.list
description: The lunch menu per school day in start..end (default today..+6) for the account's schools or one school (id): items with allergen tags and excluded_for, the children whose restrictions exclude the item. A school day without a menu has menu_published false.

name: bellnote.payments.list
description: Payments (form fees and lunch top-ups) with status paid or refunded, paid in start..end (default the last 60 days), optionally for one child.

name: bellnote.notifications.list
description: Notifications about what the school, the cafeteria or the other guardian did, in start..end (default the last 30 days), optionally of one kind.

name: bellnote.preferences.get
description: Account preferences (email notices, default payment method) and payment methods with expired/usable computed from the clock.

name: bellnote.absences.report
description: Report an absence (one day or a range of up to 10 school days), a late arrival or an early leave (one day, with time_local inside that day's school hours) for child id, with a reason. Needs your custodial right. An absence must be reported before the first day's absence cut-off; a late arrival can be reported until the stated arrival time and an early leave until the stated leaving time.

name: bellnote.absences.cancel
description: Cancel a submitted report (id) for its days that have not passed their cut-off; days already past stay reported. Needs your custodial right.

name: bellnote.forms.respond
description: Answer form id for child_id: sign with the required answers, or decline. Needs your can_sign right for the child. form_version must be the current version shown by forms.get. Signing a form with a fee needs your can_pay right and charges payment_method_id (or the default) once; signing again after a change charges only a fee increase.

name: bellnote.forms.withdraw
description: Withdraw your own answer (form response id) while the form is open; a paid fee is refunded. An answer by another guardian is refused (not_yours).

name: bellnote.pickup.person_add
description: Add a person who may collect child id: name, relationship and phone, and optionally the person_id the school already holds. Needs your custodial right. The person is matched by person_id, else by a phone number the school already holds, never by name; a person restricted for the child is refused. Where the school's policy reviews additions the person counts only once the office approves them.

name: bellnote.pickup.person_remove
description: Remove a pickup person (id) from a child's list. Needs your custodial right. Refused while a dismissal change still ahead names them.

name: bellnote.dismissal.set
description: Set how child id goes home on one school day (date): mode pickup with the person_id of an approved guardian or pickup person, or bus, after_care, walker. Needs your custodial right. Replaces an earlier change for that day; must be made before that day's dismissal-change cut-off.

name: bellnote.dismissal.cancel
description: Cancel an active dismissal change (id), yours or another custodial guardian's, before that day's dismissal-change cut-off; the child's default way home applies. Needs your custodial right.

name: bellnote.lunch.topup
description: Top up lunch account id by amount_cents from payment_method_id (or the default). Needs your can_pay right for the child. The amount must be inside the top-up range of the child's school (schools.get policy). A top-up is final in the portal.

name: bellnote.lunch.settings_update
description: Set the low-balance threshold and/or the daily spending limit (null clears it) of lunch account id, each from 0 to 10000000 cents. Needs your can_pay right for the child.

name: bellnote.preferences.update
description: Turn email notices on or off and set the default payment method.
